message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Seeking Efficient Ways to Export OpenRouter Chat Logs as PDFs for Training Sessions","body":"I've been using OpenRouter mainly for development, running tests across multiple models to balance quality and cost. The website's chat interface is great for comparing AI responses side-by-side. Some conversations turn out valuable after I edit them—mostly trimming out weaker responses and keeping the best ones. Since my training sessions rely on PDF instructions, I'd really like to export these chats in a reusable, well-formatted PDF or similar format. I'm aware of the JSON export option, but it doesn't suit my needs for presentation. Does anyone know of tools or workflows that can import OpenRouter chat logs or work with multiple models to produce nicely formatted chat exports without manual reformatting? Any advice on automating this process or alternative approaches would be appreciated.","fact_refs":["F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","F6"]}]}
